title: Ctrl-` and Cmd-D right after Cmd-T always give a new terminal that takes the keys; the old terminal gets none of them
why: Lawrence on v2.2.9-opt (4 h session): "at some points I can no longer make new terminals via Ctrl-` or Cmd-D". Fleet repro 4/4 (cmux17, cmux20, cmux21): the New Tab page's new-conversation-tab held the app's daemon connection, the Ctrl-` new-tab missed the 5 s client start deadline, the app took the stand-in back, and the typed line ran in the OLD terminal. Invariant (principled-audit R3): Ctrl-` and Cmd-D always give a terminal that takes keys, whatever the New Tab spare and the daemon's latency.

steps.title: Cmd-T shows the New Tab page with the keyboard
Ctrl-` gave a new terminal and the typed line runs there
Cmd-T again shows the New Tab page
Cmd-D from that terminal gave a split terminal that takes the keys
the old terminal got none of the keys typed for the new ones
